<div class='command-title'>Syntax highlight the input string.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> nu-highlight {flags} ```

## Flags

 -  `--reject-garbage, -r`: Return an error if invalid syntax (garbage) was encountered.


## Input/output types:

| ------ | ------ |
| string | string |
